title: Diversity Collective Ventura County | LGBTQ+ Community Resource Center
contentSummary: Homepage introducing DCVC mission, Community Resource Center on Portola Rd, signature annual events, and newsletter signups.

title: About Us | Diversity Collective Ventura County
contentSummary: Mission, vision, core values statement, DEI commitment, 2014 founding history, and leadership biographies (Tess Allen, Roland Catabona, Steve Somann, Unique Dowtin, Luis Andrade, Celia Sandhya Daniels, AJ Holmes).

title: Programs & Services | Diversity Collective Ventura County
contentSummary: Overview of flagship community operations: Community Resource Center drop-in hours, Rainbow Umbrella (13-23), Little Unicorns (9-13), Diversity SHINES health initiatives, and cultural competency workshops.

title: Rainbow Umbrella Youth Peer Support | Diversity Collective
contentSummary: Weekly youth peer group (ages 13–23) meeting Fridays 5:30–7:30 PM at the CRC. Offers activities, check-ins, mental health resilience, and Pride Prom planning.

title: Little Unicorns (Ages 9–13) | Diversity Collective
contentSummary: Monthly youth gathering for younger LGBTQ+, questioning, and ally kids on the last Saturday of each month (1:00–3:00 PM) at the CRC and local parks.

title: Diversity SHINES Health & Wellness | Diversity Collective
contentSummary: Sexual health education, free rapid confidential HIV and STI testing (syphilis, chlamydia, gonorrhea), PrEP/PEP linkage, MPOX coordination with VCPH, and 'SHINE With Me' safer sex kit distribution.

title: Community Resource Center | Diversity Collective
contentSummary: The physical hub at 2471 Portola Road, Suite 100, Ventura, CA 93003. Drop-in hours (1-5 PM weekdays), computer lab, lending library, peer groups, and harm reduction supplies.

title: Cultural Competency & Educational Trainings | Diversity Collective
contentSummary: P.R.I.D.E. 4-hour cultural competency workshops for educators, medical professionals, and corporate organizations, developed in partnership with Ventura County Behavioral Health.

title: DCVC Community Events | Diversity Collective
contentSummary: Annual signature calendar: Ventura County Pride Festival, Diversity Gala, Pride Prom, and AIDS Walk Ventura, plus weekly/monthly peer groups.

title: Ventura County Pride | Diversity Collective
contentSummary: Seaside Pride festival celebrating community resilience, queer artists, food, and public health pavilion with free testing.

title: Diversity Gala | Diversity Collective
contentSummary: Premier annual fundraising evening recognizing regional community leaders and corporate champions of equity.

title: Pride Prom | Diversity Collective
contentSummary: Annual safe, affirming, sober prom for youth ages 13-23 hosted by Rainbow Umbrella.

title: AIDS Walk Ventura | Diversity Collective
contentSummary: Walk to remember those lost to HIV/AIDS, combat healthcare stigma, and raise funds for Diversity SHINES.

title: LGBTQ+ Resources & Referrals | Diversity Collective
contentSummary: Community partner referrals: Ventura County Behavioral Health, Public Health, The Transverse, PFLAG Ventura, Silver Collective, and crisis helplines.

contentSummary: High-level overview of ways to support DCVC: volunteer applications, direct donations, and corporate sponsorship opportunities.

title: Volunteer With Us | Diversity Collective
contentSummary: Volunteer application instructions for CRC greeters, event support, and youth mentoring.
